# proximity to

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:proximityTo`](gmeow-proximityTo.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/proximityTo>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The target entity to which proximity is measured. Functional: a different target entity is a different proximity measurement (constitutive of the relator's identity).
